title: Evaluation of AI Ethics Tools in Language Models: A Developers’ Perspective Case Study

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation through structured interviews and questionnaires assessing whether AI Ethics Tools (AIETs) help language model developers identify the lack of representation of cultural and social aspects of Brazilian and Portuguese-speaking populations.
Using various AI Ethics frameworks as interview guides to prompt developers to self-assess the risk of low performance in the Portuguese language (a medium-resource language) compared to English.

Evaluating developer awareness of exclusionary norms, unfair discrimination, and lower model performance across different social groups using self-assessment questionnaires based on four AI Ethics tools (Model Cards, ALTAI, FactSheets, and Harms Modeling).
